prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training day with 20km long run scheduled in the afternoon

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes carbohydrate-rich foods to support sustained energy for endurance training
Plan incorporates pre-run, during-run, and post-run nutrition timing
Includes hydration strategy appropriate for a long training day
Meal plan is compact and fits within a single day format
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with an endurance athlete (e.g., marathon runner or cyclist) who needs sustained energy, carbohydrate loading strategies, and hydration considerations throughout a long training day

prompt_inputs.goal: build muscle and improve endurance for soccer

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals and includes snacks appropriate for athletic performance
All foods comply with vegan dietary restrictions (no animal products)
Sufficient protein intake from plant-based sources to support muscle building
Plan is concise and formatted for easy daily reference
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete with dietary restrictions (e.g., vegan soccer player or pescatarian gymnast) to ensure the meal plan accommodates both athletic performance needs and ethical/religious constraints

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize strength and power for weightlifting competition in 6 weeks

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 meals with timing optimized around training session (pre-workout and post-workout meals specified)
Daily macronutrient ratios support strength/power athlete (approximately 40-50% carbohydrates, 25-30% protein, 20-25% fat)
Total daily calories align with athlete's needs for muscle development and performance
Plan is presented in a compact, single-day format that is easy to follow and implement
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (e.g., weightlifter or sprinter) who requires high caloric intake and specific macronutrient ratios, including meal timing around intense training sessions
